newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Mavesa an outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mavesa an outperform.

text.p: -- Lehman Bros analyst Will Landers said he initiated coverage of Mavesa SA with an outperform rating.
-- Mavesa is Venezuela's principal consumer products company, and Landers set a year-end price target of $9 per ADR.
-- "We are forecasting EBITDA growth of 15 percent in 1997 and 12 percent in 1998, on the back of sales volume growth and operating margin expansion," he said in a research note.

-- "Operating margin expansion will stem from an increased participation of the higher margin Yukery products in the overall sales mix as well as from raw material cost stability as Venezuela's currency becomes less volatile," Landers said.

-- "Sales volume growth will come from increasing sales volume in Yukery products, introducing new products especially in the cleaning division and expanding export levels to Andean countries. In addition, we are expecting robust growth in the Venezuelan economy during upcoming years," he added.
